small_guidance:
- Add larger BLOCK_OW configs (256) and a num_warps=16 sweep for the conv kernel; with OW=33 the current BLOCK_OW=128 already covers it in one tile so try parallelizing further along OC instead (split OC into tiles BLOCK_OC=8/16 as a second program axis) to expose more parallelism since N*OD*OH = 128*31*33 ≈ 131k programs is fine but each does full OC×IC×KD×KH×KW work.
- Fuse stage-3 GroupNorm normalize+HardSwish with stage-1 mean/var by using a 2-pass persistent kernel per (N,G): each program loads the group into registers/SRAM once, computes mean/var via tl.sum, then writes normalized+hardswish — eliminates the partial buffers, the finalize launch, and the second full read of `out`.
- Tune CHUNKS (try 8/16/64) and BLOCK_SIZE up to 8192 for the GN kernels; group_elems = 4*OD*OH*OW = 4*33*65*65 ≈ 558k so current CHUNKS=32 gives ~17k elems/chunk which is reasonable but a single-pass persistent design likely wins.
large_guidance:
- Restructure the conv-transpose as a scatter-add gemm: one program per (N, IC-tile, input-spatial-tile) computes input[n,ic,id,ih,iw] × W[ic,:,:,:,:] outer product and scatter-adds into the output grid with atomics — or, better, the standard gather form with explicit (BLOCK_OC, BLOCK_OW) tiling where the K-dim is IC*KD*KH*KW unrolled, producing a real 2D tl.dot instead of the current OC×BLOCK_OW broadcast accumulation. tl.dot on tensor cores will be several× faster than the scalar `wval[:,None]*xval[None,:]` accumulation.
- Make the conv epilogue write directly into a layout convenient for GroupNorm (e.g., keep NCDHW but ensure the group is contiguous — already true) and fuse Swish into the accumulator (already done). Then merge GroupNorm into a single persistent kernel per (N, G) that holds the group's elements (≈558k floats → too large for SRAM, so stream-twice but in one launch with no intermediate global buffers for partials).
- Consider folding the conv epilogue (Swish) and a *first-pass partial GN reduction* into the conv kernel itself: as each conv program produces its OC×BLOCK_OW tile, atomically accumulate sum and sum-of-squares into per-(N,G) partial buffers. This removes a full read of the 27MB activation between conv and GN reduce.
